name: [☃️UPD] Anime Power Defense
desc:
☄️Anime Power Defense!

⭐Summon powerful units to display and fight!
🌠Summon unique powers to equip on to your units giving them epic abilities and a creative look!
🗡️ Use your units and their combined powers to fend off challenging waves of enemy units!
⚜️ Fight in story mode to unlock more challenging maps or play with friends to complete infinite and mission mode!

📱💻Supports Desktop, Mobile, Console and Tablet players
❤️Like and Favorite the game!
🏵️Join the group for rewards and stay updated on the game's development
🔗 Tags: Tower Defense, Tower, Strategy, Survival, Defense, Anime
